description: A polyphonic oscillator for the X-Limit JI Autotuner modules: it adds its two pitch inputs in double precision and reads band-limited tables, so two pitches a fraction of a cent apart do not beat.

inputs.text: A rising edge here restarts the waveform; a monophonic cable restarts every channel together, a polyphonic one restarts each channel from its own.
Added to the pitch at the V/Oct jack before the frequency is worked out, which is where an Autotuner's residual output goes.
Sets the pitch at 1V per octave, 0V giving C4; the number of channels here is the number of channels every output carries.

outputs.text: A sawtooth read from a band-limited table, with the number of harmonics taken from the pitch so that none of them passes a fifth of the sample rate.
A square read from a band-limited table, with the number of harmonics taken from the pitch so that none of them passes a fifth of the sample rate.

notes: There is nothing to turn: the pitch comes entirely from the two input jacks, so the module is silent until one of them is patched to something other than 0V, where it puts out C4.
The module keeps eight phases but runs over as many channels as V/Oct carries, so more than eight channels writes past the end of that store. Keep the input to eight channels.
Building the two wavetables takes ten million entries each, so a new instance costs a noticeable pause and about 160MB of memory.
